let lang='en',crop='onion';function tr(k){return (dict[lang]&&dict[lang][k])||dict.en[k]||k}function setLanguage(l){lang=l;document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.lang===l));Object.keys(dict.en).forEach(k=>{let e=document.getElementById(k);if(e)e.textContent=tr(k)});document.getElementById('splashTag').textContent='हर फसल का सही भाव, हर किसान का सम्मान';document.getElementById('brand').textContent=l==='en'?'Kissan Mitra':'किसान मित्र';document.getElementById('tag').textContent=tr('tag');render()};document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>setLanguage(b.dataset.lang)));document.querySelectorAll('[data-crop]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{crop=b.dataset.crop;document.querySelectorAll('[data-crop]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('selected',x===b));render()}));document.getElementById('saleForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();render();document.getElementById('results').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'})});document.getElementById('quantity').addEventListener('input',render);document.getElementById('unit').addEventListener('change',render);document.getElementById('vehicle').addEventListener('change',render);document.getElementById('location').addEventListener('input',()=>document.getElementById('locationSummary').textContent=document.getElementById('location').value||'—');const rupees=n=>'₹'+Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN');function render(){const q=Math.max(0,Number(document.getElementById('quantity').value)||0)*(document.getElementById('unit').value==='t'?10:1),v=document.getElementById('vehicle').value,rate={mini:22,medium:30,large:40}[v],cap={mini:40,medium:100,large:180}[v],trips=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(q/cap)),base={onion:1800,tomato:1400,potato:1200}[crop],tomato=crop==='tomato',shelf={onion:14,tomato:4,potato:21}[crop];const data=[{id:'local',name:tr('local'),distance:12,price:base,delta:1,fee:1.5},{id:'regional',name:tr('regional'),distance:210,price:base*(crop==='onion'?1.22:1.16),delta:3,fee:2}].map(m=>{let hours=m.distance/35+1.2,gross=q*m.price*(1+m.delta/100),freight=m.distance*rate*trips,loss=gross*Math.min(25,(hours/24/shelf)*(tomato?22:8))/100,fees=gross*m.fee/100,net=gross-freight-loss-fees;return {...m,hours,gross,freight,loss,net,perq:q?net/q:0}});const local=data[0].net;data.forEach(m=>{let adv=local>0?(m.net-local)/local:0;m.status=adv>.04&&m.id==='regional'?'dispatch':adv<-.04?'avoid':'hold'});data.sort((a,b)=>b.net-a.net);document.getElementById('results').innerHTML=data.map((m,i)=>`<article class="result ${i===0?'best':''}"><div class="resultHead"><div><div class="kicker">${m.id==='local'?tr('local'):tr('regional')}</div><h3>${m.id==='local'?'Pune Mandi (local demo)':'Nashik Mandi (regional demo)'}</h3></div>${i===0?`<span class="demo">${tr('best')}</span>`:''}</div><div class="small">${tr('net')}</div><div class="net">${rupees(m.net)}</div><div class="small">${rupees(m.perq)} ${tr('perq')}</div><div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><span>${tr('price')}</span><strong>${rupees(m.price)} / q</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>${tr('distance')}</span><strong>${m.distance} km</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>${tr('arrival')}</span><strong>${Math.floor(m.hours)}h ${Math.round((m.hours%1)*60)}m</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>${tr('freight')}</span><strong>−${rupees(m.freight)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><span>${tr('loss')}</span><strong>−${rupees(m.loss)}</strong></div></div><div class="status ${m.status==='dispatch'?'green':m.status==='avoid'?'red':'yellow'}">${tr(m.status)}</div></article>`).join('');document.getElementById('locationSummary').textContent=document.getElementById('location').value||'—'}render();setTimeout(()=>{const el=document.getElementById('intro');if(el)el.remove()},3300);
